Title: HTC-28096: RS485 Interface - Bus Impedance
Purpose: Check if the RS485 interface is terminated with 120 ohms (+/-5%) and resistor termination technic.

Inputs.1: Signals RS485_TX_N (pin 23 or 44) and RS485_TX_P (pin 24 or 45)
Inputs.2: Signals RS485_RX_N (pin 25 or 46) and RS485_RX_P (pin 26 or 47)

1.Expected: The bus impedance between these pins shall be of 120 ohms, with resistor termination technic.
